summary: Tested the CloudIVR landing fax/number rework (API + UI). Hero purpose cards (Voice/SIP/SMS/Fax with price and CTAs), eSIM/try links, Pricing fax tab (product-card-fax $15, search US/CA, nearby note, pick -> continue), the visitor flow (pick -> signup?plan=fax -> buy?purpose=fax with only Fax selected, no onboarding modal, pick preselected, top-up because the wallet is $0), and the funded flow (signed-in pick -> 'Get +1...' -> pay in DRY RUN without searching again -> /app/fax) all work. Public APIs all pass (offer, search with nearby flags, GB 400, 429 on call 31). One real bug: the 4 new fax FAQ questions are in faqItems but the landing FAQ never shows them, because it renders faqItems(...).slice(0,10) and the fax items are at index ~19-22.

minor.issue: The per-IP rate limit uses the FIRST X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. A spoofed XFF got its own budget of 30 (429 came at call 31 under a random fake IP), so anyone can get around the limit by changing the header. Use the last trusted proxy hop (or req.ip with trust proxy set) instead.

Telnyx is not consistent for 212. curl returned 1 nearby number twice, but one UI search seconds later returned 0 (fax-landing-none shown). This is upstream sparsity, not a code bug. Consider widening nearby/best-effort results when the list is empty.

ui_bugs.issue: The fax FAQs ('What is a fax number?', 'How much does fax cost?', 'Can I pick my fax number before I sign up?', 'How do I send and receive faxes?') do NOT show on /cloudivr. Faq renders faqItems(catalog).slice(0, 10) and the fax entries come after index 10. Only the first 10 (eSIM/texting/trial/pay) appear. They do show on Help (slice(2)). Fix: move the fax items into the first 10 or render a fax-specific subset.

design_issues.screen: Pricing 'What will you use it for?' chooser
issues: Has 6 options (calls, menu/desk phones, campaigns, AI, texts, USA line on phone) but no fax option, which doesn't match the new 4-purpose arrangement.
Bottom bar says 'Order eSIM or number'. Fax/Business Line wording is not reflected (minor).
Sidebar highlights 'Get a Business Line' while the user is buying a fax number (minor).

action_items: Make the 4 fax FAQ items visible in the landing FAQ (they are cut off by slice(0,10) in PricingFaq.js Faq)
Rate-limit the public fax search by the trusted client IP, not the first spoofable X-Forwarded-For value
Optional: add a fax option to the 'What will you use it for?' chooser on the Pricing section
critical_code_review_comments: PricingFaq.js: the landing FAQ uses faqItems(...).slice(0,10), so any item added past index 10 never shows on the landing page.
fax.js publicRoutes: the hits Map is cleared completely once it passes 5000 keys, which resets every visitor's limit; the XFF first-hop is spoofable.
fax-numbers.js buy(): any number in faxNumberSeen (searched by any visitor within 2h) can be bought by any account. Acceptable by design, but note it.
FaxNumberBuy: the preselected pick from sessionStorage doesn't keep or show the country/region. The buy uses the seen-doc country, so it is functionally fine.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all flows pass; fax FAQ wording requirement fails)

seed_data_creation: New account qa.fax1794590207@example.com / QaTest#2026x (recorded in test_credentials.md). civr.uxtest bought dry-run fax number +18076960264 ($15 debited from preview wallet), then marked 'released' in Mongo faxNumbers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public fax search is rate limited to 30/hour per first-XFF IP. The pytest uses a random spoofed XFF for the 429 test so it doesn't burn the real IP's budget. 212 is sparse at Telnyx; use 305 (nearby-only results) or CA for reliable results. Retest: faq-question-* on /cloudivr should include the 4 fax questions.
